units.source_text: 致老尼姑的信中并无特别事情，但说：

en.t: The letter to the old nun contained nothing in particular, but said:

units.source_text: “我定于是月十四日离此草庵，

en.t: "I have decided to leave this grass hut on the fourteenth of this month,

units.source_text: 遁入深山，将以此无用之身施舍熊狼。

en.t: and withdraw into the deep mountains, giving this useless body of mine to the bears and wolves.

units.source_text: 但仍望你长生住世，以待夙愿之成遂。

en.t: Yet I still hope you will live long in this world and wait until our long cherished wish is fulfilled.

units.source_text: 你我当在极乐净土再相会面也。”

en.t: You and I shall meet again in the Pure Land of Bliss."

units.source_text: 老尼姑看了此信，便向送信来的僧人探问情由。

en.t: After reading the letter, the old nun questioned the monk who had brought it about what had happened.

units.source_text: 僧人答道：“师父写此信后三日，即移居人迹不到的深山中。

en.t: The monk answered, "Three days after writing this letter, our master moved into deep mountains where no human footsteps reach.

units.source_text: 贫僧等一齐走送，但行至山麓，即被遣返。

en.t: We monks all went on foot to see him off, but when we reached the foot of the mountain, he sent us back.

units.source_text: 随行者只一僧人及二童子。

en.t: Only one monk and two young attendants went on with him.

units.source_text: 师父昔年弃家学道，我等以为已极悲哀之情，

en.t: When our master left home years ago to pursue the Way, we thought that was already a matter of deepest sorrow,

units.source_text: 岂知更有此悲哀之事！

en.t: but who could have known there would be an even sadder thing than this!

units.source_text: 师父年来修行之暇，常倚床弹琴，或奏琵琶。

en.t: In recent years, in the intervals of his practice, our master often leaned by his bed to play the koto, or played the biwa.

units.source_text: 此次临行，取此二乐器在佛前弹奏，向佛告辞。

en.t: This time, as he was about to depart, he took up those two instruments, played them before the Buddha, and bade the Buddha farewell.

units.source_text: 并将乐器施入佛堂。

en.t: He then donated the instruments to the Buddhist hall.

units.source_text: 其他种种器什，多数捐献寺院。

en.t: Most of his other various belongings were donated to the temple.

units.source_text: 其余物件分赠平素亲近之弟子六十余人，借留遗念。

en.t: The remaining articles were divided among more than sixty disciples who had long been close to him, to keep as mementos.

units.source_text: 尚有剩者，今已运来京都，以供尊处使用。

en.t: What was still left has now been brought to Kyoto for use in your household.

units.source_text: 师父舍我等而去，深入山中，隐身云霞之间。

en.t: Our master abandoned us and went away, entering deep into the mountains and hiding himself among the clouds and mist.

units.source_text: 此地空留陈迹，悲叹之人甚多。”

en.t: Here only the old traces remain in emptiness, and there are very many people grieving and lamenting."

units.source_text: 此僧人童年随明石道人由京都下明石浦，今已成为老法师。

en.t: This monk had followed the Akashi monk from Kyoto down to Akashi Bay when he was a child, and had now become an elderly priest.

units.source_text: 此次明石道人入山，此僧人不胜悲伤。

en.t: Now that the Akashi monk had entered the mountains, this monk was overwhelmed with sorrow.

units.source_text: 即使是释迦牟尼佛诸弟子中之圣者，并且确信佛涅槃后常住灵鹫山，

en.t: Even the holy ones among Shakyamuni Buddha's disciples, though they firmly believed that after his nirvana the Buddha would always dwell on Vulture Peak,

units.source_text: 但当“薪尽火灭”之时，亦不免深为哀悼。

en.t: still could not help mourning deeply when the fuel was spent and the fire went out.

units.source_text: 何况老尼姑闻此消息，当然悲伤无限。

en.t: How much more, then, must the old nun have felt boundless grief when she heard this news.
